source: Project Operating System Phase 2 - Migration Engine
description: Risk levels for future migration planning.

items.description: Isolated declarative or metadata change with no production path impact.
Limited structural change that may affect one asset and requires equivalence evidence.
Change touching shared structure, SEO, layout, runtime adjacency or multiple assets.
Migration cannot proceed until a blocking dependency, validation issue or approval gap is resolved.

notes: Risk levels guide future planning and do not authorize file changes.
